args.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent animation sprite sheet with EXACTLY eight complete BigVitamin mascots, in four equal columns and two equal rows, row-major order. No labels, grid lines or backgrounds. Each cell has one entire connected mascot and generous clear gutters. Keep both ears inside each cell.
Image1 is the current shipped101 model/style: limbless cream-white overlapping rectangular PAPER layers, yellow/orange accents, square orange cheeks, exactly two long oval bunny ears, warm taupe-brown fine readable outer contour and restrained fold lines. Match its normal body volume, body-to-ear ratio, two ear roots and outline weight. Image2 fixes the USER-SELECTED open brown eye diameter, spacing and small white highlights. Preserve that relative eye size. Image3 demonstrates the current joyful prop rendering only. Images4/5 are ORIGINAL anatomy/expression authorities. No arms, hands, legs, feet, paws, fur or hat. Animate through the connected paper body, two ears, layer compression and gaze; do not add anatomy.
Cell1: ASK-PETTING: front-three-quarter, slightly lifts the face and leans toward the viewer with expectant open eyes and a tiny warm smile; relaxed two ears.
Cell2: LEAN-NUZZLE: same volume, body leaning affectionately sideways, eyes softly closed, cheek forward, two ears gently following the tilt. No external person or hand.
Cell3: PAPER-KNEAD-LEFT: low settled body, alternating pressure in the LEFT front paper layers, opposite layers gently raised, absorbed closed smiling eyes. No sofa, cushion or ground is drawn.
Cell4: PAPER-NEST-RIGHT: matching opposite knead, RIGHT front layers compress and tuck, two ears relaxed, cozy nesting expression. Preserve clear connected paper folds.
Cell5: CHEER-TANGLED: small soft lavender/yellow cheering tassels caught in the side paper layers, a harmless awkward crossed tangle in front, surprised open eyes. Props are tucked into paper, never held by invented hands.
Cell6: CHEER-PEEK: the SAME tangle and tassels, shy sideways glance up toward the viewer, sheepish little smile and one ear tilting; both ears visible.
Cell7: CHEER-TIDY: same small tassels now neatly arranged beside the paper body, relieved closed-eye smile, calm upright finish. No extra character.
Cell8: DOZE-CURL: low cozy settled paper body with gently tucked front layers, closed sleeping arcs, tiny relaxed mouth and BOTH ears softly folded but visibly attached. No zzz text, bed or blanket.
Maintain expressive differences without changing identity or independently resizing facial/body parts. Crisp clean warm matte cel illustration, genuinely transparent alpha throughout all gutters. No checkerboard, halos, shadow floor, tiny detached scraps, duplicate ghosts, text, cropping or merged neighboring cells.
